representation: Structured projection of the immutable reviewer memo; full source references and required owner dispositions remain in that memo.

findings.counterexample: A fresh unclaimed local task needs no parent-held task transfer, while a parent-held task cannot be transferred under non-delegating B.
findings.required_disposition: Operator and task/integration owners select first-use assurance and included/excluded cases; explicitly revise inherited requirement applicability.

findings.source: RFC lines58-68,81-86,106; decision-inputs G1; design admission
findings.counterexample: An allowed actor string is not authenticated identity; claim success followed by message-admission failure has unresolved recovery effects.
findings.required_disposition: Pin assurance-appropriate owner operations and claimant/failure recovery; no implied transfer, authentication or launch-local grant.

findings.counterexample: Missing/throwing optional input handler or command-shaped initial payload bypasses the expected refusal.
findings.required_disposition: Allocate mandatory supported startup boundary and explicit denial/error/other-turn behavior with source-grounded negative narratives.

findings.source: RFC lines82-86,108,119-121; decision-inputs lines39-45; design R3/B3/V3
findings.counterexample: Hash H is admitted but another extension transforms it to H2 or starts a separate turn; private bytes may be exposed before the model gate.
findings.required_disposition: Define trusted startup resources/effects and exact payload-transform rejection or revalidation; distinguish privacy from model admission and avoid sandbox claims.

findings.source: RFC lines85-87,109; design lines119-127 and B7/B8/V5
findings.counterexample: Old generation survives reassignment; different task IDs share a checkout but evade a tuple-only lock; candidate/launch lock order deadlocks.
findings.required_disposition: Specify canonical namespace/conflict keys, durable reservation/recovery, non-bypassing lock order or no nesting, and owner quiescence/fencing/overlap route.

findings.counterexample: Production options.exec activates test shortcuts; development TS imports work while packed emitted-JS dependencies are absent.
findings.required_disposition: Ratify coherent same-package production ports and emitted-JS boundary; retain G2-P1 and packed/observer proof as later affected-use gates, not pre-ADR implementation.

findings.source: RFC lines111,125-131; design G3/B11/V7; discovery lane-script row
findings.counterexample: Legacy multi-task print callers silently become interactive or withdrawal revives unsafe direct Ghostty spawning.
findings.required_disposition: Choose compatibility/coexistence/withdrawal contract or explicit first-release migration exclusion with separate owner gate; never unsafe automatic fallback.

non_material_nice_to_have: One compact example contrasting fresh claimable task, parent-held refusal under B, and indeterminate prior attempt requiring inspection.
closure_limit: This inventory records open findings, not disposition or runtime authority. A new review requires a changed verified candidate and finding-level resolutions.
